logo.shipped: A rising price line (#3b82f6, stroke 30) inside a quiet ring (#fafafa at 35%, r 160, stroke 12).
logo.constraint: The app frames the mark in a circle twice — BiometricLock's disc and Android's adaptive mask. A ring may nest inside them, but only a quiet one: weight and contrast relative to the enclosing frame decide it, not whether the shape is closed. An earlier rule banned closed containers outright and was wrong. Green, amber and red remain unavailable: they mean gain, degraded data and loss.
logo.authoredBy: hand-authored SVG imported free; GRAPHIC.md's raster path is unsuitable for a mark that must be vector and legible at 24px

conventions.timeframes: One canonical list in packages/core/src/ranges.ts. Screens offer a subset via RangePicker's `only` prop — never a second list. Everyday periods (1D 1W 1M 1Y All) stay inline; the rest collapse behind More on a phone and sit inline from md: up. The selected period never collapses.
conventions.importCaveat: import-design-draft rejects `{}` in inline handlers as an unresolved JSX expression. Write brace-free JS (arrow bodies without braces).
conventions.chartAxes: Price axis only where the level is read. Portfolio value and the Insights comparison hide it; the asset price chart keeps it with axisMoney() compact labels.
conventions.authority: BRAND.md is the design authority. design-system.md defers to it and adds only agent-specific context; pass both as --context-file.
conventions.figures: Values are set in the sans face with tabular-nums. Geist Mono is for identifiers and code only — tickers, rule ids, script source.
